> **LATEST PRODUCT OWNER DECISIONS — 2026-11-09 (Asia/Jakarta):** (1) `/kalkulator/emas` is **ACCEPTED AS MANUAL SIMULATION**, without an automatic/live gold-price feed; (2) `/bandingkan` marketplace comparison is **ACCEPTED AS MANUAL SIMULATION**, without automatic official tariff presets. These owner acceptances address the two manual-scope *product choices only*; they do not certify calculation errors, all third-party content, legal/tax claims, historic feature parity, SEO behavior, or production readiness. **No code, domain, DNS, alias, current canonical or indexing changes authorized. Cutover STRICT NO-GO.**

> **LATEST OWNER DECISION (supersedes previous apex choice; 2026-11-09 Asia/Jakarta):** Owner has corrected their intended canonical host to **https://www.kalkulatorharga.com** (www). This replaces the previously recorded `https://kalkulatorharga.com` apex choice. **PLANNING ONLY — not permission to change active domain/DNS/alias/canonical/redirect/indexing.** Current v2 code canonical remains apex until a separate explicitly approved code/change PR and final cutover authorization. Preserve current legacy apex → www redirect unless and until an explicitly approved change requires otherwise. For future www-primary plan, propose apex → www one hop with path/query handling subject to review. Domain cutover remains NO-GO.

# Owner decision log — domain migration preparation (NO CUTOVER AUTHORIZATION)

**Original decision recorded:** 2026-11-09 (Asia/Jakarta). **SUPERSEDED by the latest owner correction above.** **Owner explicitly selected the intended future canonical host** in the conversation:
> "Saya memilih https://kalkulatorharga.com (tanpa www) sebagai canonical utama untuk rencana migrasi. Catat sebagai keputusan owner dan lanjutkan checklist SEO, konten, dan rollback. Ini belum izin mengubah domain, DNS, alias, canonical aktif, atau indexing."

## Superseded prior decision (historical record only — DO NOT APPLY)
- **Chosen canonical hostname for a *future migration plan***: **`https://kalkulatorharga.com` (apex/non-www)**.
- Proposed future direction, subject to separate approved implementation: **`www.kalkulatorharga.com` → `https://kalkulatorharga.com` with a path/query-preserving one-hop 301 where relevant**. Current legacy `apex → www` 308 must not coexist with an opposite direction; plan must remove/replace it atomically enough to avoid loops and allow rollback.
- This approval **does not** authorize any change to currently deployed canonical metadata, sitemap, robots/indexing, SSO, Vercel domain/aliases, DNS, hostname redirects or production deployments. This issue is an external planning record, not a mutation of the release register in `main`. Register currently still represents the historical audit and must be updated in a separate reviewed source PR with provenance before any release gate claims host policy approved.

## SEO checklist — evidence/approval still needed
- [ ] **NEW www primary choice:** create separate reviewed change to v2 canonical origin, sitemap URLs, OpenGraph/metadata if applicable, and www-host one-way redirect plan; do not activate without specific approval.
- [ ] Owner supplies six-month GSC export for relevant verified host/domain property: indexed pages/pages+query pairs, clicks, impressions, position, CTR, sitemaps, crawl/index anomalies, export time and filters.
- [ ] Owner supplies GA4 organic landing pages, sessions/key events, timezone and reporting range; no personal data.
- [ ] Backlink/referring-page shortlist and important legacy URLs/404 from available analytics. Do **not** assume 32 crawled content URLs cover every indexed/backlinked URL.
- [ ] Review all 131 published v2 URLs and both proposed path redirects by search intent and queries. No automatic mass redirect of unmatched/benchmark URLs to home.
- [ ] Document one-hop future host redirect and rule ordering, no apex→www plus www→apex loop; do not activate. Canonical origin remains unchanged until a separate approved cutover.

## Content / feature checklist — approvals still needed
- [ ] Owner/content/legal/editor reviews 22 inherited archives including republication rights, bylines/entity, privacy/editorial promises, tariff/legal factual freshness, original publication dates and corrections; record decisions per URL, not a blanket approval inferred from tests.
- [ ] Owner decides disposition of old 200 `/kalkulator/tiktok/benchmark` versus current v2 404: licensed/reproducible data, SEO-reviewed retirement, or correctly scoped replacement; no made-up values.
- [ ] Owner resolves six remaining historical nonclick reference instances and provenance after moving same domain; no phantom archive link.
- [ ] Product owner explicitly accepts manual-scope gold and four-way marketplace comparison versus old live/preset experiences, or identifies exact missing parity. Existing 100 calculators unchanged.
- [ ] Evaluate two proposed path redirects (`/kalkulator` and `/kalkulator/saham/average`) with evidence and explicit per-route approvals.

## Operations / rollback checklist
- [ ] Verify retained legacy apex→www 308, avoiding any simultaneous opposite www→apex rule. Future intended host is www; refresh host policy model and runbook after new approval.
- [ ] Confirm migration candidate HEAD SHA / READY deployment for v2 and frozen legacy rollback SHA/deployment **on the actual day**, correct Vercel team/project IDs, both host assignments.
- [ ] Named operator, backup operator and decision owner; permissions to move both Vercel domains and restore them; maintenance window, contact channel and incident decision points.
- [ ] Snapshot and preserve current legacy host assignments, redirects, TLS/cert, DNS/TTL, env/indexing settings and health metrics before action; check actual recovery path. No passwords/PII/tokens committed.
- [ ] Validate planned one-hop host/path routing, both-host HTTPS/TLS, critical legacy paths, production robots/sitemap/canonical (only after explicitly authorized launch), staging SSO/noindex remains.
- [ ] Real platform rollback rehearsal or evidence-backed operator procedure with STOP/rollback triggers (partial host move, redirect loop, TLS, 404/5xx, incorrect canonical/indexing), and observed recovery timing. Synthetic JS fixture is **not** proof of live rollback.
- [ ] Separate **explicit final owner cutover instruction** identifying exact SHA/project/deployments, hostnames, host/path redirect rules, any DNS/alias/canonical/indexing changes, release window, rollback operator and trigger thresholds.

**Cutover remains STRICT NO-GO until other mandatory gates are closed and a separate execution authorization is given.** Do not merge/create PR on the basis of this issue automatically; no production, domain, DNS, alias, canonical or indexing changes authorized.

References:
- PR #59 merged, main baseline `2f3f1b8ec18e8e555c0193faa1e282bd175614e4`.
- `docs/MIGRATION_RELEASE.md`, `docs/MIGRATION_CUTOVER_RUNBOOK.md`, `docs/audit/migration-release/register.json`.


## Follow-up audit after manual-scope acceptance — 2026-11-09 (planning, NO-GO)

**Owner-approved product choices (already recorded):** gold uses manual user quote without live feed; marketplace comparison uses manual user-entered rates without official presets. Do not conflate product acceptance with legal/tax guarantee or entire release approval.

### 1. `/kalkulator/saham/average` — redirect NOT approved
- GitHub proposal `docs/audit/redirect-proposals.csv`: `/kalkulator/saham/average` → `/kalkulator/rata-rata-beli-saham`, 301, `approved_for_production=no`.
- Legacy flow includes additional break-even/impas assumptions not yet demonstrated equivalent to v2. Owner-provided GSC export previously showed organic clicks at the legacy path. **Do not apply this redirect** until independently checked old→new inputs, transaction fees and break-even examples, query usage and on-page intent. Consider preserving exact path if not equivalent; this needs a separate reviewed code/routing decision.

### 2. `/kalkulator/tiktok/benchmark` — keep decision pending
- Legacy 200, v2 404, not in sitemap. Historical 3 tables/16 rows in `docs/audit/deferred57/benchmark-inventory.csv` have unverified reuse rights, date, cohort, geography, denominator and quartile methods.
- Previous short GSC export indicated impressions but no clicks for this path; **0 clicks is not proof of zero SEO value or approved retirement**.
- No fake official statistics, no silent redirect to a generic engagement calculator. Owner must supply licensed reproducible dataset, approve an evidence-backed removal after URL/index/backlink impact review, or approve a genuinely equivalent replacement.

### 3. Archive owner review queue (22 paths, approvals still absent)
- Priority A: legal/privacy/editorial entity claims: `/metodologi`, `/redaksi`, `/kebijakan-editorial`, `/disclaimer`, `/update-tarif`. Check that privacy/process promises are actually followed and that historic bylines are authorized.
- Priority B: current-fee/tax/seller claims: `/biaya-admin-marketplace`, `/blog/fee-shopee-2026`, `/blog/pph-22-marketplace`, `/blog/gratis-ongkir-xtra-shopee-2026`, `/blog/tokopedia-tiktok-shop-komisi-dinamis`, `/blog/lazada-marketplace-vs-lazmall`, `/blog/biaya-admin-marketplace`, `/blog/cek-dana-cair-shopee`, `/blog/harga-jual-minimum-marketplace`. Verify tariff date, source, category, legal jurisdiction, and calculation claims.
- Priority C: historical/educational posts: `/kalkulator/tiktok/panduan`, `/blog`, `/blog/menghitung-margin-marketplace`, `/blog/strategi-naikkan-profit`, `/blog/kalkulator-vs-spreadsheet`, `/blog/memilih-marketplace-untuk-mulai-jual`, `/blog/engagement-rate-tiktok-2026`, `/blog/kalkulator-average-down-saham-harga-rata-rata`. Verify accuracy, citations, source rights and especially average-down example fee/impas.
- These three work queues partition all **22** inherited archive paths; they are a **review prioritization, not owner approval**. Each decision requires path, authorized reviewer, publication/revision disposition and source evidence. Retaining content on v2 staging is not sign-off to publish.

### Reminder
Owner selected **www** future canonical; active v2 canonical remains apex. GSC/GA4/backlink coverage, 6 historical nonclick references, two candidate redirects, production TLS/domain operator/snapshot/live rollback, and exact execution authorization remain pending. **NO CODE OR ACTIVE HOST/CANONICAL/INDEXING CHANGES. CUTOVER NO-GO.**


## Phased content audit — Batch 1: policy, tax, marketplace tariffs (2026-11-09)

**Scope and method:** Read actual archived SSR content from `lib/legacy/pages.json` at `main@2f3f1b8ec18e8e555c0193faa1e282bd175614e4`. Compared factual assertions with current v2 manual product scope and attempted primary-source checks (DJP; marketplace Seller Education linked from source). These are **risk findings, NOT owner approvals or production edits**. **13/22 archive URLs were reviewed in this batch; 9 remain for subsequent batches.** Archive text is preserved unchanged. Reviewer authorization, republication rights and real operational practices still UNKNOWN.

### Critical (HOLD — fix/owner review before releasing unchanged)
1. `/kebijakan-editorial` — claims TikTok username search, server reading public profiles and **not storing usernames**; these are specific feature and privacy promises, unverified against v2 and potentially inaccurate after migration. Also says all seller tariffs automatically sourced, verified and stored per row; v2 seller scope accepted as **manual inputs without official presets**. Owner/privacy + product must verify and revise; do not publish unchanged as v2's current policy.
2. `/metodologi` — states default official marketplace tariffs with subcategory status, exact-match fallback, dated verification, and broker fee assumptions. This describes legacy data-driven logic, not the accepted manual v2 comparison or necessarily other v2 tools. Old rate snapshots (18 Oct 2026, Shopee 1 Aug, Tokopedia/TikTok 18 May, Lazada 1 Feb) may be useful historically but require primary tariff evidence and scope labels, not a promise of fresh v2 defaults.
3. `/redaksi` — makes assertions that current editor verifies every tariff row, validates against official Seller Center and maintains changelog; names a generic historical editorial persona. Requires authorized responsible entity/byline, evidence of workflow actually performed, and correction for v2 manual scope.
4. `/blog/gratis-ongkir-xtra-shopee-2026` — states rate auto-filled from official tables, fixed percentage/category/cap numbers, newcomer waivers and future Shopee rate change dates. No fully fetchable current primary table was established from the linked Shopee Seller Education site (HTML responded app shell only). Historical numbers must be independently checked by seller tier, category and date. Avoid presenting as verified current schedule.
5. `/biaya-admin-marketplace` — publishes granular multi-marketplace rate grid and process fees (including 2026 Shopee/Tokopedia/Lazada) while v2 comparison is manual; old "Buka kalkulator" references were intentionally converted to notes. Needs citation per row, temporal banner/date and a non-misleading account of **what v2 does**; avoid calling the legacy table "current official" by implication.
6. `/update-tarif` — labels internal 63-row dataset verified 18 Oct 2026, automatic rate and cap behavior, dated planned Dec 2026 / Jan 2027 revisions. Historical verification is not evidence of live 2026-11-09 accuracy. Do not imply v2 has an automatic update pipeline or verified tariffs unless independently demonstrated.

### High (HOLD / revise factual claims)
7. `/blog/pph-22-marketplace` — generic conditional PPh22 explanation but cites Lazada fees as if sufficient to document tax law. Must link primary DJP/PMK37/2025, distinguish 0.5% tax withholding from fees, exemptions/documentation and **effective date**. DJP official sources currently conflict about launch date: an official 1 Oct 2026 press release at `https://stats.pajak.go.id/id/siaran-pers/pemungutan-pph-pasal-22-melalui-marketplace-mulai-dilaksanakan-1-oktober-2026` vs an official postponement announcement at `https://pajak.go.id/index.php/id/pengumuman/penundaan-waktu-pemberlakuan-ketentuan-pemungutan-pph-pasal-22-oleh-marketplace` describing 1 Nov 2026. Reconcile authoritative/latest official document and implementation evidence before asserting date. Official FAQ `https://pajak.go.id/marketplace` gives special small-seller reporting exceptions (e.g. qualifying personal sellers with documented IDR500m annual turnover statement); do not imply tax applies identically to all seller transactions. No automatic tax/legal rates approved.
8. `/disclaimer` — carries TikTok username profile-lookup/sampling and endorse benchmark claims that may **not exist** as described in v2. Disclaimer is a live policy claim, not an innocent historical article. Must align with current actual implementation and privacy process, even though general limitation language is helpful.
9. `/blog/tokopedia-tiktok-shop-komisi-dinamis` — suggests automatic base/dynamic commission separation and comparison against legacy official tariffs. v2 accepts manual rate entries; revise instructions to avoid implying official presets/current category mapping.
10. `/blog/lazada-marketplace-vs-lazmall` — treats tax and seller-mode options as if built-in and validated; distinguish explanatory article from actual fields/rates of v2 and verify claims against Lazada primary seller documentation.

### Medium (fact-check and align instructions before approval)
11. `/blog/fee-shopee-2026` — conceptual fee breakdown useful; program cap/status assumptions and references to "main calculator" may be legacy behavior. Check fee applicability and current manual-input instructions; historical citation link is not alone proof of present validity.
12. `/blog/biaya-admin-marketplace` — conceptual categories/status/process fee useful; phrase "all numbers share same verified tariff/date as calculator" is inconsistent with v2 manual rates. Update CTA/product language and verify citations.
13. `/blog/cek-dana-cair-shopee` — says calculator rounds **each component** to nearest rupiah whereas current settlement engine may round at ledger total; do not approve until independently checked against actual engine/rounding tests and corrected. Statements "almost always one component" are overconfident.

### Evidence limitations / next review
- Independent web verification: DJP `https://pajak.go.id/marketplace`, `https://pajak.go.id/index.php/id/pengumuman/penundaan-waktu-pemberlakuan-ketentuan-pemungutan-pph-pasal-22-oleh-marketplace`, `https://stats.pajak.go.id/id/siaran-pers/pemungutan-pph-pasal-22-melalui-marketplace-mulai-dilaksanakan-1-oktober-2026` and PMK37/2025. Contradictory implementation notices noted, not resolved. Shopee primary `https://seller.shopee.co.id/edu/article/24877` and `https://seller.shopee.co.id/edu/article/7216` produced largely client-rendered shell in this browsing pass, so **no current precise Shopee tariff grid verified**. Lazada/Tokopedia fee tables not yet independently substantiated by direct fetched primary tables.
- Remaining **9/22**: `/kalkulator/tiktok/panduan`, `/blog`, `/blog/menghitung-margin-marketplace`, `/blog/strategi-naikkan-profit`, `/blog/kalkulator-vs-spreadsheet`, `/blog/memilih-marketplace-untuk-mulai-jual`, `/blog/engagement-rate-tiktok-2026`, `/blog/kalkulator-average-down-saham-harga-rata-rata`, `/blog/harga-jual-minimum-marketplace`.
- **No archive owner sign-off granted**: all 22 still require per-path review, authorization to reuse text/bylines, and content-disposition decision. No code/canonical/DNS/domain/alias/indexing changes permitted; www remains only the planned host; **cutover NO-GO**.


## Phased content audit — Batch 2 COMPLETE (remaining 9/22) — 2026-11-09

**Scope:** All remaining nine `lib/legacy/pages.json` SSR archive entries reviewed against actual v2 functionality and first-party source where feasible; base `main@2f3f1b8ec18e8e555c0193faa1e282bd175614e4`. **22/22 archive pages have now been reviewed for risks, but 0/22 approved for publication.** This is editorial triage, not a forensic verification of all claims or third-party republication rights. Code and current host remain unchanged.

### CRITICAL factual defect — do NOT publish unchanged
1. `/blog/kalkulator-average-down-saham-harga-rata-rata`
   - Historical article says position total capital IDR **6,626,000**, **1,500 shares**, sell fee **0.25% inclusive**, break-even approx **IDR 4,436**, first valid sale **4,440 after rounding to a 5-rupiah tick**. This is **arithmetically inconsistent**: with those assumptions the exact break-even is **6,626,000 / (1,500 × 0.9975) = IDR 4,428.4043… per share** and at IDR **4,430**, net proceeds are **IDR 6,628,387.50**, already above the claimed capital. Article also conflicts internally on ticks: BEI's official trading-rule table says the **2,000–under 5,000** tier is a **10-rupiah tick**, not five. Independent first-party reference: `https://www.idx.co.id/id/produk/mekanisme-dan-jam-perdagangan` (Peraturan II-A Kep-00136/BEI/09-2026). Furthermore the total buy commission implied by 2,100,000 gross extra purchase → ~2,126,000 cost looks unusually high; inspect actual account/broker fee and explicitly reconcile all fixtures. **OWNER CONTENT / FINANCE REVIEW REQUIRED**. Preserve old article only as marked historical until corrected by authorized publication; do not approve redirect `/kalkulator/saham/average` until target independently passes break-even/parity tests.

### HIGH risk — source/rights/claims
2. `/blog/engagement-rate-tiktok-2026`
   - Quotes precise Socialinsider/SociaVault/Rival IQ benchmark numbers and cohorts; no source dataset/license, periods, computation, numerator/denominator reconciled. Comparison of rate per views with median per followers risks invalid conclusions. Claims "per views is more honest" and interpretations about view retention are not universal: engagement is not a watch-time retention metric. Remove/qualify numerical benchmark claims unless primary source usage rights and cohort metadata verified. **Not permission to publish `/kalkulator/tiktok/benchmark`**, which remains 404. The article link to a generic TikTok calculator is not equivalent to benchmark.
3. `/kalkulator/tiktok/panduan`
   - Creator Rewards summary uses all views as inputs, whereas official program pays for **qualified** views and videos must meet program rules; source TikTok: `https://support.tiktok.com/id/business-and-creator/creator-rewards-program/how-is-the-creator-rewards-program-different-from-the-tiktok-creator-fund`. Eligibility/available countries, baseline IDR0, payout path and exact follower/video requirements must be date/region-qualified; review claimed **Indonesia unavailable** against current official region info rather than citing blogs. Affiliate GMV×commission is gross model; actual eligible/returned orders vary. Third-party endorse rate cards not automatically licensed benchmarks. Avoid unsupported "all videos/regions eligible" impression.
4. `/blog`
   - Index amplifies linked articles with unreviewed fees/tax and TikTok study statistics, e.g. describes benchmark median/quantiles from 2026 despite dataset gate 404. Some CTA refers to legacy root/presets, which were made nonclickable; editorial text and destination still need rewrite. Don't publish index as unconditional approval of linked pages.

### MEDIUM risk — v2 product-scope or methodology alignment
5. `/blog/menghitung-margin-marketplace`: says "margin profit divided by **selling price**" but final numerator is after marketplace charges/HPP and potential non-included tax/ad/returns. Clarify **margin on gross sales** vs net realized revenue, distinguish commission/withholding tax and cash flow, don't call all remainder net profit if costs excluded. Repeated "all rates share same verified date as calculator" conflicts with owner-accepted v2 manual seller rates.
6. `/blog/strategi-naikkan-profit`: broadly acceptable as general guidance but says all figures share verified tariff date and presents unsupported universal claims about bundling/HPP. Label illustrative conditional assumptions; replace legacy automatic-tariff promises and review source/byline.
7. `/blog/kalkulator-vs-spreadsheet`: asserts calculator contains sourced effective-date *automatic* tariff mappings, rate caps and renewals; this does **not** describe owner's approved manual marketplace comparison. Spreadsheet may be perfectly accurate; revise inaccurate superiority claim and the arbitrary 3-month re-verification threshold as advice, not factual rule.
8. `/blog/memilih-marketplace-untuk-mulai-jual`: conceptual comparison of equal basket quantity/HPP generally sensible; fix untranslated "understand", clarify manual rates, explicit shipping/program evidence, and false "same verified rate/date" footer. Cross-scenario basket assumptions vary, not blanket recommendations.
9. `/blog/harga-jual-minimum-marketplace`: current steps "fee at tentative price + HPP + target margin" **do not constitute a solved min-price formula** when fee is % of selling price, cap thresholds or margin target is defined against revenue. Require explicit solver or iterative price calculation, unambiguous margin definition, all cost inputs and example oracle; clarify source vs manual fee assumption.

### Consolidated one-PR remediation backlog — after explicit owner authorization
**Batch P0 (must resolve for launch):**
- Correct or clearly retire false current feature/privacy claims on `/kebijakan-editorial`, `/disclaimer`, `/redaksi`, `/metodologi` and `/update-tarif`; verify product/data retention practices against code and real ops, confirm entity/byline and legal rights.
- Fix numerically false stock break-even article and accompanying narrative; independently test sample and BEI tick based on official reference. Review `/kalkulator/saham/average` route as separate migration disposition; preserve old URL if not truly equivalent, no silent 301.
- Remove unsupported "verified official preset tariff" promises in marketplace archival articles, `/biaya-admin-marketplace` rate matrix and linked blog; date-stamp and substantiate each rate or mark history, with approved sources.
- Resolve PPh22 effective-date contradictions with current DJP primary evidence and applicable exceptions; never invent automatic law/tariff.
- Fix misleading creator program paid-view and regional eligibility claims; keep benchmark tables deferred until methodology/rights verified.

**Batch P1:**
- Update remaining strategy/blog index/CTAs to manual engine scope; validate min-price percent/cap algebra, tax/margin semantics, and rounding methodology.
- Validate all crosslinks/no-click references and avoid temporary live-source promises after domain move. Preserve pre-existing routes and normalized source evidence for audit.

**Release requirements:** Owner must sign off each URL after the correction is reviewed. Prefer one *scoped PR* to avoid burning Codex budget, but do **not** treat drafting this audit as authorization to edit, merge, reindex, redirect, cutover or deploy to the custom domain. Keep current 100 baseline+2 supplemental and 131 sitemap baseline unless a later explicit separate decision changes it. www host is **planning choice only**; runtime v2 canonical currently apex. **Domain cutover NO-GO** pending owner publication approvals, benchmark disposition, six legacy references, GSC/GA4/backlinks coverage, redirect intent, www canonical change authorization, TLS/rollbacks and final operator-approved change window.

### First-party reference verified in this batch
- Indonesia Stock Exchange price fractions (II-A Kep-00136/BEI/09-2026): `https://www.idx.co.id/id/produk/mekanisme-dan-jam-perdagangan`.
- TikTok Creator Rewards qualified views/original videos eligibility: `https://support.tiktok.com/id/business-and-creator/creator-rewards-program/how-is-the-creator-rewards-program-different-from-the-tiktok-creator-fund`.
- Other dynamic fee/study/legal assertions remain conditional until individually verified; do not infer rights from a hyperlink alone.


## NEW OWNER DIRECTION — 2026-11-14: TikTok benchmark URL retained as migration target (research ONLY)

Owner explicitly selected **retain `/kalkulator/tiktok/benchmark` as an intended migrated URL** and research a **lawfully reusable, independently verifiable, intent-matching substitute dataset**. This supersedes passive retirement preference **but does NOT approve publication of a page or third-party numbers, revival from 404, redirect, source license, feature implementation, main merge, or domain/DNS/alias/canonical/indexing changes**. Status **RESEARCH_REQUIRED / PENDING_DATA_RIGHTS_AND_METHOD**; v2 remains 404 until a separate reviewed task and owner publication authorization; preserve legacy public site and staging SSO/noindex. **CUTOVER NO-GO**.

Minimum research gate: trace source owner and raw data license (including republication and derived statistics), named sample/coverage/region/date, engagement numerator, per-follower vs per-view denominators, aggregation (median/mean/quantiles), reproducible calculations and currentness, outbound attribution, and correct comparison bands. Historical 16 row/3 table legacy snapshot in `docs/audit/deferred57/benchmark-inventory.csv` is **evidence of legacy content, not licensed dataset**. Any replacement must preserve the user's benchmark/comparison intent, not generic calculator content; if license fails, seek expressly licensed/reproducible alternative. No owner content sign-offs implied.


## Benchmark replacement source screening — 2026-11-14 (read-only)

**Owner direction remains RETAIN URL AS FUTURE MIGRATION TARGET; RESEARCH ONLY. V2 route stays 404. No publication, code, domain, canonical or indexing authorization.**

**Candidate A — Crawlora TikTok Engagement Index**: `https://github.com/Crawlora-org/tiktok-engagement-data` (README `https://github.com/Crawlora-org/tiktok-engagement-data/blob/main/README.md`). Public README **claims** CC BY 4.0, 4,509 video-level observations from 13 niches, sampled via 3 search keywords/niche, excluding <10k views, snapshot 2026-06-20; promised `data/videos.jsonl` and `data/niche-summary.csv`. ER defined (likes+comments+shares+saves)/views. These statements and source license are **self-claims, not independently audited**; need actually inspect LICENSE text + downloadable raw rows, recalculate group mean/median, count duplicates, inspect coverage, privacy/ToS and original API data rights before use. The dataset is search-selected, high-view-biased, niche-centric, **NOT** a representative follower-tier cohort, not inherently the legacy median/quantiles or Indonesia-specific. Repository data/LICENSE fetch did not succeed in initial web reader; no raw-stat verification achieved. Its advertised CC BY licensing does **not itself establish** that third-party original platform data can be sublicensed unrestrictedly. **STATUS: CANDIDATE / NOT APPROVED**.

**Candidate B — Socialinsider TikTok 2026 benchmarks**: `https://www.socialinsider.io/social-media-benchmarks/tiktok` has category-by-follower-scale aggregates and specific by-views denominator; useful **methodological reference**, but reproduction of exact tables/graphs and standalone product licensing NOT confirmed. Several snapshots of page content appear inconsistent about dataset volume/date (one ~2m and another ~40.7m; some reference December 2026 though screen date is 2026-11-14). Freeze a dated copy and request explicit permission / latest authorized version before relying on numbers. Do **not** silently mix per-follower with per-view medians.

**Platform access**: TikTok official Research API `https://developers.tiktok.com/products/research-api/` and FAQ `https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/research-api-faq` indicate eligibility restrictions and **exclude ordinary commercial applicants**. Research access is not a presumptive licensing route for a commercial SEO utility.

**Next evidence gates (none passed yet):** (1) verify raw data rows/license and source chain; (2) compare follower-tier coverage, quantiles and locality to legacy intent; (3) independently reproduce calculations with documented sampling, exact periods, exclusions, denominators; (4) confirm redistribution and commercial display rights including upstream restrictions or obtain explicit written provider approval; (5) owner reviews chosen publication text/URL and authorizes a separate PR. No implementation until these gates/owner permission.


## Dataset audit — Crawlora raw data + license independently inspected — 2026-11-14

**Planning only; NO source selected, publication/implementation approval, domain/canonical/indexing change or cutover.** GitHub repository `Crawlora-org/tiktok-engagement-data` checked using GitHub file/blob reads (not README claims alone):
- `LICENSE` SHA `2c999a3a182605a8172eee36ccc038c535f0c869` explicitly states CC BY 4.0, attribution to TikTok Engagement Index by Crawlora. This verifies publisher's **stated license of its dataset**, not independently TikTok upstream acquisition or platform redistribution rights. Need provenance/legal checks before commercial republication.
- `data/niche-summary.csv` SHA `aa916a95ecc2346f8b5b8cbb48cebb108a071838`: 13 niche totals; counts sum 4,509.
- `data/videos.jsonl` blob SHA `185a8b0ba19f7e2c3232ae1f70fbbf03c8fd4c88`: **4,509** parseable JSON lines, **4,509 unique video IDs**, **3,823 unique author handles**, all views ≥ 10,000, no zero views/missing numeric follower counts in checked sample. Engagement formula `(likes+comments+shares+saves)/views` matches published `engagement_rate` to 0.00005 (rounding to 4 decimal places). All 13 niche row counts, means, medians match summary to displayed precision (≤0.00005 absolute ER difference).
- **Video publication dates span 2019-11-27 through 2026-06-20**, even though dataset snapshot date was 2026-06-20. A snapshot date is NOT an observation window/2026-only uploaded cohort; do not advertise it as all videos from 2026.
- Tentative **video-weighted** follower tiers derived from raw rows (NOT valid account-level benchmark yet): <1k: 318 videos/309 handles, median ER 7.42%; 1k–10k: 918/862, 11.27%; 10k–50k: 1099/981, 11.94%; 50k–100k: 489/398, 10.20%; 100k–500k: 922/731, 10.38%; ≥500k: 763/549, 9.96%. These are **per-video ER divided by views, with saves**, while legacy follower tiers measured per-follower account rates/quantiles. Do NOT reuse or compare them as equivalent per-follower rates; repeated handles create unequal weights and only search-selected videos with 10k+ views appear.
- Raw JSONL includes individual account handles/video IDs; do **not** commit or publish these identifiers in v2 without separate privacy/platform terms/legal review. No Indonesia geofilter/cohort or 2026-only video-period filter substantiated.

**Decision: DATASET INTERNALLY REPRODUCIBLE BUT NOT SUITABLE AS DROP-IN LEGACY BENCHMARK.** Candidate can inform a labeled "high-view per-video niche sample" supplementary exploration only if upstream rights and scope independently approved. It cannot truthfully reproduce legacy per-follower quantiles, all-account median, creator tiers, regional claims or present representative TikTok performance. Socialinsider rates can guide concepts, but republication/table license still unverified. NEXT: request provenance/raw TikTok collection rights confirmation from Crawlora (and commercial redistribution scope), seek licensed follower-tier per-account cohort or design/approve distinctly scoped replacement with owner; no PR or fake 200 until evidence and owner approval.


## Stock URL parity finding — 2026-11-14, read-only

**Legacy page checked:** `https://www.kalkulatorharga.com/kalkulator/saham/average` (legacy live indexed 200; read page contents on 2026-11-14). Legacy provides **two opening-position fee modes (gross purchase vs broker average already fee-included)**; broker presets and coverage (6 brokers, all-in vs extras), additive buy transactions; buy fee/levy/VAT, sell fee/levy/VAT/final PPh; **break-even sale price**, minimum tradable sale price rounded **UP to BEI price fractions**; sale scenario P/L grid; optional **target-average buy-lot solver**, explanatory sources and FAQ. Its core intent is more than weighted buy average.

**V2 source verified at `main@125e93d240d83ae35f63965289dd87315cb52bcc`:** `docs/CALCULATOR_INVENTORY.md` and `lib/valuation/tools.ts` lines around 165–211 show that `/kalkulator/rata-rata-beli-saham` accepts **manual share lot size**, multiple (max 100) purchase transactions (gross price/lots/buy-fee nominal) and outputs weighted cost, average per share/lot and purchase aggregates; assumes **no BEI rules preset** and no sale calculation or solver. Separate `/kalkulator/untung-rugi-saham` (same tools.ts lines 212+) accepts **manual** buy/sell prices, nominal fee and sell tax and computes net sale/profit/ROI, but is **not** a single integrated target for the old break-even/lot-target/BEI-tick/broker-preset workflow. A separate tool does not make a generic redirect to the purchase-average calculator equivalent.

**Decision/SEO risk:** Existing proposed `/kalkulator/saham/average` 301 → `/kalkulator/rata-rata-beli-saham` is **NOT FUNCTIONALLY EQUIVALENT** under current code. `docs/audit/redirect-proposals.csv` still has `approved_for_production=no`. **Do not approve, activate or import that 301**. Preferred planning option: retain the exact old path in future v2 and preserve intent by implementing an integrated calculation or verified truly equivalent equivalent URL, using existing validated library wherever possible. Any new code/redirect/site map/canonical/indexing/production change requires a separate explicit authorization and review; NO code changes from this audit.

**Independent blockers:** verify legacy broker fees/rules and legal tax/current BEI price fractions against dated official sources; compare GSC queries, page URLs and backlinks to decide SEO priority (current partial GSC extract cannot establish full 16-month history); test target-average impossible cases, broker average fee double-counting, multi-buy, zero/negative margin, price-fraction thresholds, tax and break-even rounding, SSO/noindex. Do not assert that feature parity exists merely because article about average down was corrected in PR #62 or the purchase-average tool exists. Owner www choice remains future only; 22 archives still PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL; **CUTOVER NO-GO**.

## Specification for legacy `/kalkulator/saham/average` parity — planning only (2026-11-14)

**Status: `SPEC_DRAFT / OWNER_NOT_APPROVED / NO_CODE_AUTHORIZATION`.** Source inspection: legacy observed page (per read-only parity review in Issue #60), v2 `main@125e93d240d83ae35f63965289dd87315cb52bcc`, `lib/valuation/tools.ts` (rata-rata-beli-saham and untung-rugi-saham) and `lib/valuation/engines.ts`. No implementation/redirect, no release or site/domain/indexing change authorized. Legacy existing URL should be **retained as target design**, but this is not a decision to expose it yet.

### Intent and scope to preserve on exact legacy URL
1. **Opening position in TWO explicitly distinguishable modes:** (a) gross purchase price/quantity with fee itemization and (b) broker-reported average cost **already includes buy fees**, so do not double count. Allow multiple subsequent purchases, at least as capable as legacy and with bounded input validation. Use lot size and transaction rows consistently.
2. **Accountable fees:** default **manual input as safest fallback**; brokerage presets, named broker coverage and dated tax/BEI parameters are **optional only if independently verified via first-party official sources and owner approves scope**. Never silently assume all brokers share inclusive fee/tax coverage. Clearly isolate buy fee from sale fee/tax, cap overlarge charges and prevent negative payout, model variable fee basis and rounding at the appropriate stage.
3. **Outputs:** total shares/lots, gross capital, buy fees and total cost, average price with precision, fee-inclusive average, sell-side fee/tax, exact economic **break-even sell price**, **lowest permitted sell order price** satisfying net proceeds ≥ cost (BEI daily tick-grid, where applicable), and net-profit/loss examples. Include manual sale target scenario and ROI, with clear treatment when only partial position is sold.
4. **Target-average solver:** solve for minimal additional *whole lots* at chosen buy price and buyer fee assumptions to reach requested target average; identify impossible/asymptotic cases and target already achieved (do not force bogus numerical answers); preserve integer lot steps, cap any search and show formula/assumptions. If fees are not affine/monotonic, use bounded exact search/proof or mark unsupported rather than guessing.
5. **Formula specification (when rates are confirmed):** `C = opening position cost incl buy fee + Σ(gross purchase + applicable buy fees)`; `N = opening shares + Σ(lots × sharesPerLot)`; `A = C/N`; sale proceeds `S(P,N) = P×N − sellFee(P,N) − sellTax(P,N)`; exact break-even is the smallest price `P` with `S(P,N) ≥ C` (not necessarily a simple inverse for nonlinear/capped/rounded fees). Tradable break-even = lowest BEI-valid price in the **correct daily tick interval**, validated by recomputing `S` at candidate and immediately lower permitted price. Do not round displayed average first, do not double charge buy fees, and check integer money representation.
6. **Official BEI reference checked 2026-11-14**: `https://www.idx.id/id/produk-layanan/jam-dan-mekanisme-perdagangan` cites `Kep-00158/BEI/10-2026`; current public tick grid stated: <Rp200 → Rp1; Rp200–<Rp500 → Rp2; Rp500–<Rp2,000 → Rp5; Rp2,000–<Rp5,000 → Rp10; ≥Rp5,000 → Rp25. BEI notes grid for day is based on closing price category and remains for full trading day, so a universal `tick(price)` may be misleading when price crosses interval within the same trading day; **design must explicitly specify day-fixed tick anchor/official trading rule before implementation**, and tests at all thresholds; do not assume broker order types or all markets are the same. Rates/levies, tax and broker programs remain independently unverified.

### Test oracle / acceptance before code PR
- **Existing article finance fixture:** C=Rp6,626,000, N=1,500, manual effective sell fee **assumed** 0.25% inclusive with no additional sale fees/tax: exact economic break-even Rp4,428.404344…; at hypothetical sale price Rp4,430, net Rp6,628,387.50 ≥ C; at Rp4,420, net Rp6,613,425 < C. This example proves P&L algebra, **not that Rp4,430 is a tradable BEI price**; valid tick and day-anchor must be applied separately.
- Starting broker average already fee inclusive, zero buy fee vs explicit buy fee; identical cash basis under both modes must reconcile without double counting.
- At least two buy transactions with different lots, integer shares, extreme fractional displayed average, zero purchase fee, capped/percentage fees, sell VAT/tax applicability, fee > gross rejected, value overflow, and exact rounding at each required fee component.
- Target solver: target already satisfied; buy price incl fees below/equal/above target; impossible and nonmonotonic fee/cap case; minimal whole-lot proof via one-lot predecessor.
- BEI thresholds (199→200, 499→500, 1,999→2,000, 4,999→5,000) with the **daily tick anchor**, predecessor price, order minimum, and market-type restrictions, all under dated official sources.
- Crawl/no-JS, mobile 320/375px, focus labels/form errors and screen reader output, URL 200 only after independent reviewed implementation, SEO metadata/schema/date and no fake default price source, preserve noindex/SSO until later release approval.

### Existing code reuse and architecture
- Reuse `calculateAverageStock` and `calculateStockProfit` conceptual/validated exact integer arithmetic when input assumptions align; `lib/valuation/engines.ts` currently accepts manual buy fees and manual sell costs; these **DO NOT implement** integrated break-even/target solver or broker schedules. Put new dedicated controller/engine and examples behind exact legacy route in **separately owner-approved PR** only. Do not mutate current calculators or activate `docs/audit/redirect-proposals.csv` proposed 301.
- Evidence gates: fresh GSC per-URL queries/indexation and backlinks, official broker pricing/fee inclusion, taxation/BEI rule date, independent financial fixture verification, owner explicit feature scope and release sign-off. A feature implementation approval, merge approval, and actual domain cutover are three distinct decisions.
- **Benchmark** `/kalkulator/tiktok/benchmark` remains a separate **data rights/methodology research blocker** (URL retain as future target, no dataset chosen, v2 404), all 22 archives `PENDING_OWNER_APPROVAL`, WWW host future planning only, **CUTOVER NO-GO**.
